messages:
DeployBot: Deploy fanout started -> env=prod; patch=release/2026-03-20; tag=rc3; targets=[runtime, api, console]; rollout=staggered (console -> api -> runtime). logs: https://deploys.internal/1769991234 :rocket:
Maria Chen: ack received. monitoring hooks enabled.
Kevin Park: FYI I scheduled a short change window (15m) to observe canary metrics.
DeployBot: console: started on prod-cluster-2 (podset-a). commit=abc1234.
Oliver Grant: console should be green quickly, small surface area.
DeployBot: console: success ✅ (all checks passed). duration=58s.
DeployBot: api: started on prod-cluster-3 (podset-b). commit=def5678.
Rana D'Souza: watching api p99 and 5xx. setting alert threshold to 1% 5xx for canary.
DeployBot: api: partial success — 2/10 instances reported transient 502 spikes; autoscaler reporting brief CPU burst.
Kevin Park: seeing 502s in logs, sample: `GET /v1/generate 502: upstream reset by peer`
Oncall SRE Bot: Incident pre-check: creating incident draft INC-2026-141 in PagerDuty, notify on escalation.
Maria Chen: any heavy query patterns in canary traffic?
Oliver Grant: can confirm one batch job hit an unexpectedly long prompt (seq=4096) on two api replicas.
Kevin Park: that could have pushed token processing over threshold. We should decide rollback or pin.
DeployBot: runtime rollout pending — will start after api finish; currently paused by health gate.
Rana D'Souza: proposal: abort runtime start, pin runtime to previous stable tag (v1.12.3) and continue api/console only.
Maria Chen: +1, keep runtime pinned so other teams don't get hit. We can re-run runtime after a patch.
Oliver Grant: agree. Do we have a quick patch to limit seq length or throttle?
Kevin Park: short patch ready — middleware cap prompt_len=2048, binary available. But patch needs a quick test, ~20m.
Maria Chen: okay, proceed with pin for runtime now and continue api. Rana, can you run the pin?
Rana D'Souza: doing it now. command:
```
deployctl pin --service runtime --env prod --tag v1.12.3 --reason "canary 502s due to long prompts"
```
DeployBot: runtime: pin applied to v1.12.3 for prod by Rana D'Souza. previous rollout cancelled for runtime.
DeployBot: api: continued rollout -> health stabilizing, now 10/10 instances healthy.
Kevin Park: verifying logs — 502s dropping, p95 latency back to baseline.
Oncall SRE Bot: Alerting suppressed for this change window. Will re-enable if 5xx > 1% for 5m.
Maria Chen: good job team. Next: schedule runtime patch and a short canary run before restart.
Oliver Grant: I'll drop a PR with the middleware cap and a smoke test.
Rana D'Souza: creating a follow-up thread for runtime patch rollout. link: #eng-releases (thread followup)
DeployBot: fanout summary: console=success; api=rolled out (stabilized); runtime=rollback/pinned to v1.12.3. Change window closed at +15m. commit summary: console@abc1234, api@def5678, runtime@v1.12.3.
Maria Chen: adding release note: "Prod rollout 2026-03-20: console and api updated; runtime pinned due to canary 502s; runtime patch planned."
Kevin Park: marking deploy as partial-success. closing thread unless issues arise. :white_check_mark:
